Judgment

The Sub-Inspector of Police of Halasurugate Police Station has filed this charge against the accused for the offences punishable u/Sec.51(B), 63 of Copyright Act & Sec.483, 486 & 420 of IPC.
02.

The brief facts of the prosecution case are that, on 09.10.2019 in between 3.15 to 3.50 pm within the limits of Halasurgate Police Station, in shop No.16/1, P World Stationary shop, 1 st Floor, Bajaj Complex, SP Road, Bengaluru, the accused was manufacturing of spurious/counterfeit toners of HP Company of CW.1 without obtaining any permission from the CW.1 and were selling the duplicate toners to the public and cheated the CW.1 and also public and thereby the accused has committed offences punishable u/Sec. 51(B), 63 of Copyright Act & Sec.483, 486 & 420 of IPC.
03.
After filing of charge sheet this court took cognizance for the offence punishable u/Sec. 51(B), 63 of Copyright Act & Sec.483, 486 of IPC and issued summons to the accused.
Accordingly the accused has appeared before the court through his counsel and enlarged on bail.

Later on charge sheet copies and prosecution papers were furnished to the accused under Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.
As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused, the charges has been framed and the same were read over to him, but he denied the contents of charge and claimed for trial.
Hence, the case was posted for prosecution evidence.

05. The prosecution in order to prove its case, has not examined any of the witnesses in spite of repeated issuance of NBW against CW.01 to 06 the concerned agency failed to execute the same to the said witnesses and brought them before this court.
Further, the witnesses are remained absent even after recalling them, hence prayer of learned Sr.APP is rejected.
CW.01 to 06 were dropped and closed the side of the prosecution evidence, as there is no incriminating circumstances against the accused persons.
Hence, the accused statement U/Sec.313 of Cr.P.C. is dispensed with and posted for judgment.
06. In order to prove the guilt of the offence as alleged against the accused persons by the prosecution, the prosecution has not at all examined any one of the witnesses.

It is relevant to note that, the prosecution has cited six witnesses and in spite of issuance of summons warrant against the CW.01 to CW.06, the prosecution has utterly failed to secure the presence of CW.01 to CW.06.

sentences.text: Though this Court issued coercive process of witness warrant against CW.01 to CW.06, the executive agency did not return process of proclamation and witness warrant.
Therefore, this Court dropped out CW.01 to CW.06.
Therefore, this Court proceed in accordance with law.
Hence, prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt of the offences as alleged against the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Thereby accused is entitled for the benefit of doubt.

Hence, I proceed to pass following;
ORDER
By exercising powers conferred U/sec. 248(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused is acquitted for the offence punishable u/Sec. 51(B), 63 of Copyright Act & Sec.483, 486 & 420 of IPC.

The bail bond and surety bond of the accused shall continue in force for a period of 6 months for the purposes of section 437(A) of Cr.P.C.
The accused is set at liberty.
